author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 15; ensure at least four current turns classified as billing_refund across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer bought a smartwatch that stopped charging after a week.

messages.content: Hi, my smartwatch arrived Tuesday but it won't charge anymore.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried a different cable or outlet?
Yeah, tried two cables and three outlets. Nothing.
Understood. Since it's within 30 days, I can set up a return for a replacement or refund.

variants.text: Let's do the refund, please.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, can you just tell me if the newer model has a better battery?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Refund it, and also — is the newer model waterproof?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but received a floor lamp instead.

messages.content: I ordered the desk lamp but got a floor lamp in the box.
That's frustrating. Would you like a replacement desk lamp sent out?
Hmm, actually I've been thinking about it.
Take your time. I can also process a return with a full refund if you prefer.

variants.text: You know what, I'll keep the floor lamp after all. Thanks anyway.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: I'll take the refund instead of the replacement.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Send the replacement desk lamp, and also refund the shipping I paid.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer's package shows delivered but they never received it.

messages.content: Tracking says my package was delivered yesterday but I never got it.
Let me look into that. Can you confirm your delivery address on file?
It's 42 Maple Street, same as always.
Thanks. The carrier marked it as left at the front door. I'll open an investigation.

variants.text: While you do that, can you tell me if this brand makes a larger version of the same item?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: If it doesn't turn up, I want a refund, not a reshipment.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Can I speak to a supervisor about this? I'm really fed up.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer wants to cancel a subscription box before the next billing cycle.

messages.content: I need to cancel my monthly snack box before it renews.
Sure, I can help with that. Your next charge is on the 15th.
Right, and I don't want to be charged for another month.
I can cancel it now so no further charges occur.

variants.text: Great, go ahead and cancel it.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Wait — if I cancel, do I get a partial refund for the current month I already paid?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Cancel it, and also reset my password since I keep getting locked out.
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase and wants to sort it out.

messages.content: The vase arrived cracked. Photos attached.
I'm sorry about that. I can offer a replacement or a refund.
I'd rather not deal with another fragile shipment.
Totally fair. A refund would go back to your original payment method.

variants.text: Okay, refund it then.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, hold on — is the replacement packed better than last time?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Refund it, and please make sure my account notes say no glass items ever again.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer asks about a gift they ordered for a friend's wedding.

messages.content: I ordered a photo frame for a wedding gift last week.
Lovely! Let me check the status for you.
It was supposed to arrive by Friday for the ceremony.
I see it's out for delivery today, so it should make it in time.

variants.text: Oh perfect, thanks for checking!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Great. And can you also check if my other order — the candles — shipped yet?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: If it doesn't arrive by tomorrow, I want to return it and get my money back.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer's account was locked after too many login attempts.

messages.content: I can't log in, it says my account is locked.
That happens after several failed attempts. I can unlock it for you.
Please do, I was typing my old password by mistake.
No problem. I've unlocked it — try logging in again now.

variants.text: It worked, thanks a lot!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Works now. Also, I want to return the headphones I bought last month — they hurt my ears.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Can you tell me what your return window is for opened electronics?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer ordered two identical coffee mugs but only one arrived.

messages.content: I ordered two mugs but only one was in the box.
Let me verify that order. I see two mugs on the invoice.
Yeah, the box only had one though.
I'll ship the missing mug out right away at no cost.

variants.text: Actually, I changed my mind — just refund me for the missing one instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks, that works. Oh wait, I also need to update my shipping address for next time.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: No, forget it — I don't want the second mug anymore.
variants.label: __DEFER__
